datasets.title: Sudan: Humanitarian Needs
datasets.description: This dataset was compiled by the United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (UNOCHA) on behalf of the Humanitarian Country Team and partners. It provides the Humanitarian Country Team's shared understanding of the crisis, including the most pressing humanitarian need and the estimated number of people who need assistance, and represents a consolidated evidence base and helps inform joint strategic response planning.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/sudan-humanitarian-needs]
datasets.details: Humanitarian needs data up to 2024 were provided manually from OCHA field offices on an annual basis. From 2024 onwards, Humanitarian needs data will be updated automatically through OCHA's HPC tools API.

entity.name: United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (UNOCHA)

lineage.description: Humanitarian needs data compiled by UNOCHA from cluster methodologies and partner assessments across multiple years (2015-2026). The dataset aggregates people in need (PiN) estimates by administrative divisions, population groups (IDPs, refugees, host communities, non-displaced), and humanitarian clusters, representing the consolidated evidence base for joint strategic response planning in Sudan.

sources.name: United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (UNOCHA)
sources.description: Consolidated humanitarian needs assessment compiled by UNOCHA on behalf of the Humanitarian Country Team, aggregating cluster-level needs data and population group classifications.
